_comment: M-BOOKING-CONFIRMATION test payloads — POST a scenario object to the M-BOOKING-CONFIRMATION webhook URL. These are internal Make-to-Make call payloads (not Stripe webhooks). See M-BOOKING-CONFIRMATION.spec.md § Test Steps for the full procedure.
curl_example: curl -X POST "https://hook.us1.make.com/REPLACE_WITH_YOUR_M_BOOKING_CONFIRMATION_HOOK_ID" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '<paste one of the scenario objects below>'

1_sss_happy_path_with_phone._description: SSS happy path — client has phone number. Expect: SSS-branded confirmation email sent from hello@shesaidsail.com, SMS sent via Quo API, Booking Status advanced (CONFIRMED or AGREEMENT_PENDING depending on Airtable record), BOOKING_CONFIRMED Slack alert, CONFIRMATION_SENT audit event.
1_sss_happy_path_with_phone._test_prerequisites: Replace 'recBOOKINGSSS001' with a real Booking record ID in tbl72omPibBkn2hZL with Status=DEPOSIT_PAID and Brand=SSS. The record should have Charter_Date, City, and Deposit_Amount set.

2_sss_happy_path_no_phone._description: SSS happy path — no phone number. Expect: confirmation email sent only. SMS modules 5/7 do NOT fire (filter blocks on empty client_phone). All other downstream modules fire normally.
2_sss_happy_path_no_phone._test_prerequisites: Replace 'recBOOKINGSSS002' with a real Booking record ID in tbl72omPibBkn2hZL.

3_me_happy_path_with_phone._description: Mare Executive brand — full happy path with SMS. Expect: ME-branded email sent from hello@mareexecutive.com (formal tone, ME subject line), SMS sent with ME branding, Status updated, ME audit and Slack events fire.
3_me_happy_path_with_phone._test_prerequisites: Replace 'recBOOKINGME001' with a real Booking record ID in tbl72omPibBkn2hZL with Brand=ME.

4_agreement_pending_path._description: Agreement Pending routing test — ensure the Booking record in Airtable has Agreement_Signed=false and Total_Amount > 5000. Expect: Booking Status updated to AGREEMENT_PENDING (not CONFIRMED). Email still sends. Audit log shows new_status=AGREEMENT_PENDING.
4_agreement_pending_path._test_prerequisites: Replace 'recBOOKINGAGREE001' with a real Booking record ID where Agreement_Signed=false and Total_Amount > 5000 in the Airtable record.

5_concierge_payload_fallback._description: Concierge fallback test — concierge_name and concierge_email are provided in the payload. If the Airtable Booking record has no Concierge_Name set (empty), the ifempty() expression should use these payload values in the email body. Verify the email body shows 'Lily Chen' as concierge.
5_concierge_payload_fallback._test_prerequisites: Replace 'recBOOKINGFALL001' with a real Booking record ID where Concierge_Name is empty/null in Airtable.

6_invalid_booking_id_error_path._description: Error path test — invalid booking_id will cause Module 2 (Airtable ActionGetRecord) to fail. Expect: Make error handler triggers, Module 11 sends SCENARIO_ERROR to M-AUDIT-LOGGER, Module 12 sends urgent Slack alert to #sss-ops-alerts. Scenario fails gracefully.
6_invalid_booking_id_error_path._test_prerequisites: Ensure M-AUDIT-LOGGER and M-SLACK-ALERTS webhook URLs are configured before running this test so error notifications are observable.

7_me_no_phone_agreement_signed._description: Mare Executive — no phone, Agreement_Signed=true on Airtable record. Expect: ME email only (no SMS), Booking Status advances directly to CONFIRMED (Agreement already signed), CONFIRMATION_SENT audit event with new_status=CONFIRMED.
7_me_no_phone_agreement_signed._test_prerequisites: Replace 'recBOOKINGME002' with a real ME Booking record where Agreement_Signed=true in Airtable.
